svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.26k stars in total, about 1.8k a year earlier. jactionlint 318, mr boxington 715, aube 2061, fnox 2361, hk 1305, pitchfork 712, usage 1074, +6 more 718.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
